Kontext Bench
	

Kontext Bench is a benchmark for image editing models consisting of source images paired with image editing instructions and category tags.
The benchmark comprises 1026 unique image-prompt pairs derived from 108 base images from diverse sources. It spans five core tasks: local instruction editing, global instruction editing, text editing, style reference, and character reference.
